project_details.name: Just Ayurveda
project_details.description: Premium, age-gated intimate wellness and men's wellness storefront.
project_details.tone: Discreet, premium, minimal, medically responsible, trustworthy.

scales.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#233232]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. p-8 to p-16 for containers. Lots of breathing room. Soft, elegant shapes.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-3xl for main containers, rounded-2xl for cards
spacing_and_layout.glassmorphism: Only small amounts (Sticky header, Floating WhatsApp button). backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#edfbf0]/70

buttons.primary: bg-[#3bb44b] hover:bg-[#61a06c] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-colors shadow-sm font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#8dac96] text-[#233232] hover:bg-[#cfecd6] rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.whatsapp_floating: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 rounded-full p-4 bg-[#3bb44b] text-white shadow-lg hover:bg-[#233232] transition-colors flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer

cards.product: bg-[#ffffff] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300 border border-[#cfecd6]

components.navigation: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#edfbf0]/80 border-b border-[#cfecd6]
components.age_gate: Shadcn Alert Dialog, Full screen overlay with dark gradient from #233232 to #4f5958, white text, 18+ verification buttons
components.product_modal: Shadcn Dialog with sticky mobile CTA for 'Shop Now/WhatsApp'
components.toast: Use Sonner for minimal bottom-right toast notifications.

animations.scroll: Fade-in up on scroll using framer-motion (initial: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, whileInView: { opacity: 1, y: 0 })
animations.hero_blob: Continuous slow rotation and morphing using framer-motion. Mix gradients for the blob.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lucide-react` for icons, `framer-motion` for animations, and `sonner` for toast.
Use standard HTML + Tailwind for page layouts to maintain creative flexibility.
Use Shadcn UI primarily for Dialog (Product Modal), Alert Dialog (Age Gate popup), and Accordion (FAQ).
Ensure the Age Gate Popup cannot be dismissed without explicitly clicking the confirmation button.
Product filter/sort controls should just update state and filter the 5 static products provided.
Contact section and floating button should simulate redirect to WhatsApp.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and interactive elements for testing.
Follow the exact color palette provided in the colors object, derived strictly from the logo.
